firm_data.firm_name: Law Office of Ralph C. Lorigo
firm_data.firm_description: The Law Office of Ralph C. Lorigo was established over 35 years ago in the Town of West Seneca. Ralph Lorigo established his office as a general practice law firm, with a goal of providing exceptional legal services to each and every client.
notable_facts: Offers free consultations, as well as evening and weekend hours
Has been in practice for over 35 years

email.subject: AI for Law Office of Ralph C. Lorigo, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Ralph,

Over 35 years in, you've built a general practice that handles everything from criminal law to business matters, all while keeping evening and weekend hours for clients who need accessible counsel. That's a model that works, and it's exactly why we exist.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Buffalo to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping practices like yours compete with BigLaw.

Worth a brief conversation?

Vasu
Lucio
